rule: A value may enter a row issued at issued_at only if available_at <= issued_at (UTC date). Unknown availability means not available.

status_vocabulary.confirmed: official page states the date and the crop year
status_vocabulary.confirmed_date_inferred_crop_year: official calendar states the date; crop year inferred from the release cycle
status_vocabulary.planned_official: official notice states a planned date; actual posting not verified
status_vocabulary.estimated: no official per-year date; conservative date from an official description of the usual release window
status_vocabulary.not_published: official source states the series does not exist for that crop year
status_vocabulary.unknown: not published as of 2026-11-15 or no evidence; treated as unavailable

maize|soy.basis: Historical row-crop county estimates released between late February and mid-May of the following year; mid-May used as conservative bound
Reinstatement notice: row crops effective 2024 crop season, county estimates scheduled May 6, 2025
No 2027 release date officially published as of 2026-11-15; expected cycle is not a confirmed date

wheat_winter.basis: Historical small-grain county estimates released in December of the crop year; Dec 31 used as conservative bound
County estimates discontinued April 2024; small grains reinstated only from the 2025 crop season
December 2025 release postponed by lapse in appropriations; released March 5, 2026 15:00 ET in Quick Stats
Calendar lists County Estimates Winter Wheat on 2026-12-18; future relative to 2026-11-15, so unavailable to every issue before that date

nass_county_practice_split.scope: NE maize/soy and KS winter wheat IRRIGATED / NON-IRRIGATED county yield and area
nass_county_practice_split.available_at: same rule as nass_county_estimates for the crop year
nass_county_practice_split.basis: Practice breakdown discontinued from the 2019 crop season (NE observed last 2018 in extract; KS extract shows 2019)

nass_crop_progress.status: confirmed rule; historical per-report timestamps not in the bulk file
nass_crop_progress.level: STATE (district availability in Quick Stats not confirmed); never a county observation

census_of_agriculture.note: Not extracted in v2 (SURVEY-only stream); listed for a future irrigation experiment

cdl.rule: CDL year Y available_at = {Y+1}-03-01 (estimated) unless confirmed below; first year IA 2000, NE 2001, KS 2006
cdl.use: previous-year mask is a proxy for the crop area of the target year, never the planted area of that year

nasa_power_daily.historical_available_at: unknown (current revised snapshot); retrospective reconstruction only
nasa_power_daily.latency_unit: days between last valid date and retrieval end date in the 2026-11-14 retrieval
nasa_power_daily.revision: Recent days come from GEOS-IT and are overwritten when MERRA-2 arrives (every few months); days within ~60 days of retrieval are provisional
